abstract: "Why is my period late?" Sometimes, the most useful response begins with another question. Yet conversational AI systems may respond to incomplete health queries without seeking essential context or grounding their guidance in verifiable evidence. This paper introduces HerHealthGPT, an evidence-grounded conversational AI system designed to address these challenges in women's reproductive health. HerHealthGPT integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context-aware clarification, and source validation within an interactive web interface. Rather than responding immediately to incomplete queries, the system maintains conversational context, asks targeted follow-up questions, checks for premature conclusions, and grounds its responses in retrieved evidence. We evaluate the AI components using 540 English messages derived from 90 reproductive-health cases and conduct a prototype questionnaire study with 30 adults. Evidence retrieval improves concern-category accuracy from 54.1% to 59.3% compared with fine-tuning alone. The clarification router achieves 85.6% recall and 86.2% specificity on constructed targets. In the user study, 83.3% of participants preferred the retrieval-enabled configuration, while 25 of 30 considered its follow-up questions relevant. These findings suggest that integrating evidence retrieval with interactive clarification offers a promising approach to more transparent, context-aware reproductive-health information systems, while further clinical validation remains necessary.
zh_abstract: “我的月经为什么推迟了？”有时，最有用的回应是从另一个问题开始的。然而，对话式人工智能系统在回应不完整的健康咨询时，可能不会寻求必要的背景信息，也不会将其指导建立在可验证的证据之上。本文介绍了 HerHealthGPT，这是一个以证据为基础的对话式人工智能系统，旨在应对女性生殖健康领域的这些挑战。HerHealthGPT 在交互式网页界面中整合了检索增强生成（RAG）、上下文感知的澄清以及来源验证。对于不完整的咨询，该系统不会立即作答，而是维持对话上下文、提出有针对性的追问、检查过早得出的结论，并将其回答建立在检索到的证据之上。我们使用源自90个生殖健康病例的540条英文消息对人工智能组件进行评估，并对30名成年人开展了原型问卷研究。与仅进行微调相比，证据检索将关注类别的准确率从54.1%提高到59.3%。在构建的目标上，澄清路由器的召回率为85.6%，特异度为86.2%。在用户研究中，83.3%的参与者更偏好启用检索的配置，30人中有25人认为其追问是相关的。这些发现表明，将证据检索与交互式澄清相结合，为构建更透明、更具上下文感知能力的生殖健康信息系统提供了一种有前景的方法，但仍需进一步的临床验证。

title: Mathematical AI Predicts 40% and 57% Influenza Vaccine Effectiveness Against H1N1 and H3N2, Respectively, for the 2026--2027 U.S. Season
zh_title: 数学AI预测2026–27美国流感疫苗对H1N1/H3N2有效性
summary: 预印本利用2010–2025年美国HA序列与疫苗株的氨基酸距离，结合26个已发表VE观测，预测2026–27季H1N1和H3N2疫苗有效性分别约40%和57%。
key_points: 基于GISAID美国HA序列与疫苗株距离
与26个已发表VE估计配对建模
预测H1N1约40%、H3N2约57%
reason: 预印本，样本仅26个观测，缺外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Background: Clinical influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) has often been low over the past two decades, highlighting the need for preseason VE forecasting. Timely forecasts could help health authorities plan prevention strategies and allocate healthcare resources. However, preseason forecasting of clinical influenza VE remains relatively uncommon. Methods: We obtained hemagglutinin (HA) sequences from GISAID for U.S. specimens collected in August--September before each influenza season from 2010--2011 through 2024--2025. After quality screening, we compared each virus with the corresponding vaccine target strain for the same season and subtype or lineage using two mathematical distances based on amino acid patterns in the HA protein. We calculated mean distances for each season and subtype or lineage and paired them with published clinical VE estimates, yielding 26 observations across 13 seasons. Using a mathematical AI approach, we fitted linear regression models of VE against each distance and evaluated their predictive performance by forecasting later seasons using data from earlier seasons, with the historical mean VE for each subtype or lineage as a reference. We then applied the same approach to 87 HA sequences collected in August--September 2026 to forecast VE for the 2026--2027 season. Results: We generated component-specific forecasts of influenza VE for the upcoming 2026--2027 U.S. season. Both mathematical distances were negatively associated with historical VE, indicating that greater differences between circulating viruses and vaccine strains were associated with lower VE. The topological model forecast VE of 40.3%, 56.9%, and 47.1% against A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria, respectively, whereas the geometric model forecast corresponding VE values of 34.0%, 56.8%, and 51.1%.
zh_abstract: 【背景】过去二十年来，临床流感疫苗有效性（VE）常常较低，凸显了季前VE预测的必要性。及时的预测可帮助卫生部门规划预防策略并分配医疗资源。然而，临床流感VE的季前预测仍相对少见。【方法】我们从GISAID获取了2010–2011年至2024–2025年每个流感季前8–9月采集的美国标本的血凝素（HA）序列。经质量筛选后，我们使用基于HA蛋白氨基酸模式的两种数学距离，将每个病毒与同一季节及同一亚型或谱系的相应疫苗靶株进行比较。我们计算了每个季节及每个亚型或谱系的平均距离，并与已发表的临床VE估计值配对，得到13个季节共26个观测值。我们采用数学AI方法，拟合VE对各距离的线性回归模型，并以各亚型或谱系的历史平均VE为参照，通过利用早期季节数据预测后续季节来评估其预测性能。随后，我们将同一方法应用于2026年8–9月采集的87条HA序列，以预测2026–2027季节的VE。【结果】我们生成了即将到来的2026–2027年美国流感季各组分特异性的流感VE预测。两种数学距离均与历史VE呈负相关，表明流行病毒与疫苗株之间的差异越大，VE越低。拓扑模型预测针对A(H1N1)pdm09、A(H3N2)和B/Victoria的VE分别为40.3%、56.9%和47.1%，而几何模型预测的相应VE值分别为34.0%、56.8%和51.1%。

title: A Pipeline for Predicting Variant Associations with Complex Disorders via Functional Annotations
zh_title: 基于功能注释预测复杂疾病变异关联的流程
summary: 该预印本提出可扩展、可复现的流程，整合GWAS汇总统计与CADD注释，生成面向复杂疾病的机器学习变异数据集。
key_points: 以EFO术语定义复杂疾病
整合GWAS、基因组映射与染色体分层负采样
生成CADD注释的平衡可复现数据集
reason: 数据构建流程，摘要未见外部验证
abstract: The study of complex disorders is limited by the lack of structured data sets that integrate genetic association signals with rich functional annotations. While genome wide association studies (GWAS) provide large collections of associated variants, these are heterogeneous, studydependent, and not directly suitable for machine learning applications. Although frameworks such as Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion (CADD) offer comprehensive variant-level features, there is no standardised procedure to construct curated, balanced, and reproducible data sets for the systematic study of complex traits. We introduce a scalable and reproducible pipeline for generating CADD-annotated variant data sets associated with complex disorders defined via Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) terms. The pipeline integrates GWAS summary statistics, genome mapping, chromosomestratified negative sampling, and large-scale annotation, while addressing class imbalance and feature redundancy. The resulting data sets provide curated, balanced, and annotation-rich representations of variant-trait associations, suitable for statistical learning, systematic model evaluation and comparison, and analysis of functional annotation contributions and interactions.
zh_abstract: 复杂疾病的研究受限于缺乏将遗传关联信号与丰富功能注释相整合的结构化数据集。全基因组关联研究（GWAS）虽然提供了大量关联变异，但这些数据异质、依赖于具体研究，不能直接用于机器学习应用。尽管联合注释依赖性耗竭（CADD）等框架提供了全面的变异水平特征，但目前尚无标准化流程来构建经过整理、均衡且可重复的数据集，用于复杂性状的系统研究。我们提出了一种可扩展、可重复的流程，用于生成与以实验因子本体（EFO）术语定义的复杂疾病相关的、带有CADD注释的变异数据集。该流程整合了GWAS汇总统计数据、基因组映射、按染色体分层的负样本抽样以及大规模注释，同时处理类别不平衡和特征冗余问题。所得数据集提供了经过整理、均衡且注释丰富的变异-性状关联表示，适用于统计学习、系统性的模型评估与比较，以及功能注释贡献和相互作用的分析。

title: Automated Sleep Staging Performance Across Two Experimental Sleep Manipulation Protocols in Adolescents.
zh_title: 青少年两种睡眠操控方案下的自动睡眠分期表现
summary: 评估POPS、YASA及其组合在睡眠限制与慢波睡眠剥夺实验中对青少年多导睡眠图自动分期的有效性，对照人工判读。
key_points: 睡眠限制组43人，慢波剥夺组18人
比较POPS、YASA与POPS+YASA
检验算法在睡眠结构被操控时是否保持表现
reason: 样本小、单类人群验证的增量研究，预印本
abstract: Automated sleep staging algorithms improve the scalability of polysomnography analysis in adolescent research but are primarily validated in undisturbed, single-night sleep recordings. It remains unclear whether these algorithms maintain performance when sleep architecture is experimentally manipulated. This study evaluated the validity of two popular automated sleep staging approaches across two distinct sleep manipulation paradigms in adolescents: a sleep restriction protocol (N=43, mean age [SD]=13.37[1.06] years; four nights including two sleep extension [10hr] and two restriction [4hr] nights) and a slow-wave sleep deprivation (SWSD) protocol (N=18, mean age [SD]=17.17[1.79] years; baseline, SWSD, and recovery nights). Automated sleep staging was performed using the POPulation-level Sleep Stager (POPS), the Yet Another Spindle Algorithm (YASA), and combined POPS+YASA. Manual polysomnography scoring by experienced sleep technicians served as the reference standard. Agreement was assessed using Cohen's k, and stage-specific performance was evaluated using F1 scores and confusion matrices. Mixed-effects models tested differences in overall and stage-specific agreement across nights. All staging approaches demonstrated moderate-to-substantial agreement with manual scoring across manipulated sleep conditions (k range; range=0.53-0.76). In the sleep restriction study, agreement was lower in restricted versus extended sleep (P<0.05), and agreement declined across restriction nights, with poorer Wake, N1, and N2 classification, while N3 remained preserved. In the SWSD study, overall agreement was lower on the SWSD night, with poorer N3 classification while other stages were preserved. Automated sleep staging performance may be less consistent in adolescents when sleep is curtailed or fragmented; future studies should develop and validate these algorithms under multiple sleep conditions.
zh_abstract: 自动化睡眠分期算法提高了青少年研究中多导睡眠图分析的可扩展性，但其验证主要基于未受干扰的单夜睡眠记录。目前尚不清楚当睡眠结构被实验性操控时，这些算法能否保持性能。本研究在两种不同的青少年睡眠操控范式中评估了两种常用自动化睡眠分期方法的有效性：睡眠限制方案（N=43，平均年龄[标准差]=13.37[1.06]岁；共四个夜晚，包括两个睡眠延长[10小时]夜和两个睡眠限制[4小时]夜）和慢波睡眠剥夺（SWSD）方案（N=18，平均年龄[标准差]=17.17[1.79]岁；基线夜、SWSD夜和恢复夜）。自动化睡眠分期使用群体水平睡眠分期器（POPS）、又一种纺锤波算法（YASA）以及二者联合（POPS+YASA）进行。以经验丰富的睡眠技师手工多导睡眠图评分作为参考标准。一致性采用Cohen's k评估，各期别表现采用F1分数和混淆矩阵评估。使用混合效应模型检验不同夜晚间总体及各期别一致性的差异。在被操控的睡眠条件下，所有分期方法与手工评分均表现出中等至高度的一致性（k范围=0.53–0.76）。在睡眠限制研究中，限制睡眠与延长睡眠相比一致性较低（P<0.05），且一致性随限制夜数增加而下降，清醒期、N1和N2的分类较差，而N3保持稳定。在SWSD研究中，SWSD夜的总体一致性较低，N3分类较差，而其他期别保持稳定。当睡眠被缩短或碎片化时，自动化睡眠分期在青少年中的表现可能不够一致；未来研究应在多种睡眠条件下开发并验证这些算法。

title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
zh_title: 改进CBAM-ENet跳跃连接的节能肺肿瘤分割
summary: 该预印本在ENet上加入UNet式跳跃连接与CBAM注意力，用MSD公开数据训练，目标是降低计算量以便临床部署。
key_points: 基于ENet的轻量实时架构
加入跳跃连接与CBAM模块
使用TCIA/MSD公开数据训练
reason: 轻量分割小改进，仅公开数据，无外部验证
abstract: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.
zh_abstract: 肺肿瘤分割在肺癌的早期检测和治疗规划中起着至关重要的作用。尽管最先进的深度学习模型能够取得较高的 Dice 相似系数（DSC），但每次前向传播都需要进行大量浮点运算，计算成本高昂，需要 GPU 加速，且推理速度慢，限制了其在真实临床环境中的部署。我们提出一种轻量级、节能的模型：利用 ENet 架构的实时推理能力和低计算成本，并在编码器与解码器阶段之间加入 UNet 式跳跃连接以实现特征复用，同时引入轻量级卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）以改进特征表示。该模型使用通过医学分割十项全能挑战赛（MSD）获取的癌症影像档案库（TCIA）公开数据进行训练，并在肺部影像数据库联盟和影像数据库资源倡议（LIDC-IDRI）数据集上进行评估。我们的模型在阈值为0.5时 DSC 达到0.90812，其紧凑架构仅有430,052个参数和0.549十亿次乘加运算（GMAC），速度最高可达 UNet 的10倍，所需 GMAC 比 UNet 少79倍，参数量比 SegNet 少22倍。这些特点使其非常适合在计算资源有限的临床环境中部署，并可降低使用此类系统的成本。此外，还采用可解释人工智能技术 Grad-CAM，对模型预测提供可视化解释，并识别分割性能有待改进的区域。

title: Gender Associations in LLM-Mediated ADHD Self-Diagnosis
zh_title: LLM辅助ADHD自我诊断中的性别关联
summary: 借用上下文关联测试，评估GPT-4o在零样本ADHD自我诊断场景中对性别线索的响应，发现显式与隐式线索表现不同。
key_points: 改编Context Association Test评估GPT-4o
显式性别线索会放大部分ADHD亚型关联
隐式线索更接近代理分布，显式可能过度纠偏
reason: 预印本，单模型偏倚评估，证据有限；心理健康LLM略加分
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical self-diagnosis. However, the way demographic cues shape outputs in these interactions remains poorly understood. This is particularly consequential for diagnoses like ADHD, where persistent gender disparities are not fully aligned with the clinical evidence. We adapt the Context Association Test (CAT) to evaluate whether GPT-4o responds to gendered ADHD associations in a zero-shot, self-diagnostic setting. We show that explicit cueing consistently amplifies certain ADHD subtype associations while implicit cueing produces near proxy-aligned distributions. These divergences suggest that explicit demographic cues may activate bias-mitigation mechanisms that over-correct rather than eliminate bias, whereas implicit cues appear to reflect the model's default behavior. Our results demonstrate that evaluating gendered bias in LLM-mediated self-diagnosis requires careful attention to the demographic associations a model encodes.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于医学自我诊断。然而，在这类交互中，人口统计学线索如何影响输出，目前仍知之甚少。这对于 ADHD 等诊断尤为重要，因为其持续存在的性别差异与临床证据并不完全一致。我们改编了语境关联测试（Context Association Test，CAT），以评估 GPT-4o 在零样本自我诊断情境下是否会对带有性别色彩的 ADHD 关联作出反应。我们发现，显式提示会持续放大某些 ADHD 亚型的关联，而隐式提示产生的分布则接近代理（proxy）基准。这些差异表明，显式人口统计学线索可能激活偏见缓解机制，而该机制会矫枉过正而非消除偏见，而隐式线索似乎反映了模型的默认行为。我们的结果表明，评估 LLM 介导的自我诊断中的性别偏见，需要认真关注模型所编码的人口统计学关联。

title: Multiscale Topology-Regulated Nonlinear Dynamics for Protein B-Factor Prediction and Single-Cell Type Classification
zh_title: 多尺度拓扑调控非线性动力学用于蛋白B因子预测与单细胞分型
summary: 提出MGCBRL框架，结合代数拓扑与Burgers非线性动力学，从蛋白坐标或细胞主成分得分构建多尺度图表示，用于B因子预测和单细胞类型分类。
key_points: 在十个邻域尺度上构建加权图
节点单位脉冲响应由非线性Burgers动力学支配
同时面向蛋白结构与单细胞分类
reason: 预印本新方法，摘要未给出对比结果，属增量档
abstract: Protein B-factor prediction and single-cell type classification are important for characterizing structural variability and cellular heterogeneity, with applications in biological function analysis and drug discovery. However, static geometric descriptors do not directly capture how multiscale connectivity shapes responses to local perturbations. Here, we introduce multiscale graph-coupled Burgers response learning (MGCBRL), a framework integrating algebraic topology and nonlinear dynamics to construct predictive biological representations. Specifically, a filtration converts protein coordinates or cellular principal component scores into weighted graphs at ten neighborhood scales. Independent unit impulses initiate node-specific responses governed by nonlinear Burgers dynamics. Statistical summaries or sampled source-node trajectories then encode the influence of structural neighborhoods on transient signal evolution. The simulated responses serve as computational probes rather than models of biological motion. For cross-protein prediction, multiscale response statistics are combined with spectral perturbation descriptors measuring changes in Laplacian spectra after node removal. For single-cell classification, principal component scores augment these features to retain explicit expression-space information, and the resulting descriptors support downstream supervised learning. Across 104 proteins and 13 single-cell datasets, MGCBRL achieved configuration-selected mean scores of 0.888 for within-protein Pearson correlation and 0.950 for transductive cell classification balanced accuracy, with leave-one-protein-out mean correlations of 0.496-0.558. Our framework provides a shared strategy for transforming multiscale biological connectivity into informative response descriptors, supporting predictive analysis of protein structures and transcriptomic profiles.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质 B 因子预测和单细胞类型分类对于刻画结构变异性和细胞异质性非常重要，可应用于生物功能分析和药物发现。然而，静态几何描述符无法直接捕捉多尺度连接性如何塑造对局部扰动的响应。在此，我们提出了多尺度图耦合 Burgers 响应学习（MGCBRL），这是一个整合代数拓扑与非线性动力学以构建预测性生物学表征的框架。具体而言，通过过滤（filtration）将蛋白质坐标或细胞主成分得分转换为十个邻域尺度上的加权图。独立的单位脉冲引发由非线性 Burgers 动力学支配的节点特异性响应。随后，统计摘要或采样的源节点轨迹对结构邻域对瞬态信号演化的影响进行编码。这些模拟响应仅作为计算探针，而非生物运动的模型。对于跨蛋白质预测，将多尺度响应统计量与谱扰动描述符相结合，后者度量移除节点后 Laplacian 谱的变化。对于单细胞分类，主成分得分用于增强这些特征，以保留显式的表达空间信息，所得描述符支持下游的监督学习。在104个蛋白质和13个单细胞数据集上，MGCBRL 在配置选择下，蛋白质内 Pearson 相关性的平均得分为0.888，转导式细胞分类的平衡准确率为0.950，留一蛋白质交叉验证的平均相关性为0.496–0.558。我们的框架提供了一种共享策略，可将多尺度生物连接性转化为信息丰富的响应描述符，支持对蛋白质结构和转录组谱的预测分析。

title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
zh_title: 面向医学问答的基于扰动的数据选择
summary: 提出基于表征高斯扰动的数据选择方法RSP及RSP-Drop，在MedGemma-4B和五个医学问答数据集上，128样本预算下Macro-F1为47.55和48.28，高于随机选择的45.11（预印本）。
key_points: 利用预测变化频率与边际收缩两种信号
仅用问题与选项进行选择
预算64/128/256条，对比熵池匹配随机选择
reason: 小幅提升的方法改进，预印本，增量
abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 从现有问答库中为医学语言模型适配选择紧凑的训练子集是重要的一步。我们研究基于扰动的数据选择方法，使用对最后一个模块表征施加高斯扰动所得的两个信号：预测变化频率和非翻转间隔收缩。在共同的熵预过滤之后，表征敏感性优先排序（Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization，RSP）通过自动均方根缩放来组合这两个信号，而 RSP-Drop 仅按收缩程度对候选样本排序。两种选择器在选择过程中都只使用问题和答案选项。我们以 MedGemma-4B 在五个医学问答数据集上、保留集规模为 64、128 和 256 个样本的条件下对其进行评估。在主要规模 128 时，RSP 和 RSP-Drop 的数据集平均 Macro-F1 分别为 47.55 和 48.28，而与熵池匹配的随机选择为 45.11。二者的相对表现随数据集和规模而变化。一项针对所选集合的案例研究发现，两种规则所交换的样本具有相反的干净间隔特征；而一项全池消融实验表明，熵预过滤并非在所有情况下都有益。这些回顾性结果刻画了在固定适配方案下基于扰动的选择方法的经验效用与局限。评估仅使用一个骨干模型，且所用基准与训练数据存在已记录的同源重叠；这些结果并不能证明其临床有效性。

title: Distill, Debate, Discover: Grounding Multi-Agent Research Ideation in Graph-Distilled Insights

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support research idea generation and scientific discovery. Multi-agent debate offers a collaborative approach to this task by bringing together diverse perspectives to develop research ideas. However, a key challenge is how to equip agents with distinct and meaningful expertise to guide their contributions. Inspired by how researchers draw on accumulated research experience during collaboration, we introduce InsightAgents, a framework that constructs literature-grounded agent expertise by distilling insights from graphs of related papers. Guided by insights that trace evolving research approaches, reveal underlying assumptions, and identify unresolved challenges, within a line of research, agents jointly identify a research problem and propose, challenge, and refine potential approaches through debate to develop a research proposal. We evaluate InsightAgents against three research idea generation frameworks on 100 NLP research topics through pairwise comparisons by two LLM judges. In both online and offline knowledge settings, InsightAgents achieves the highest average score across the five evaluation dimensions under both judges.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于支持研究想法的生成和科学发现。多智能体辩论通过汇集多元视角来发展研究想法，为这一任务提供了一种协作方式。然而，一个关键挑战在于如何赋予各智能体独特而有意义的专业知识，以指导其贡献。受研究人员在协作中借鉴既往研究经验的启发，我们提出 InsightAgents，该框架通过从相关论文图谱中提炼洞见，构建以文献为依据的智能体专业知识。在这些洞见的引导下——它们追溯某一研究方向内研究方法的演变、揭示其潜在假设并指出尚未解决的挑战——智能体共同确定研究问题，并通过辩论提出、质疑和完善潜在方法，从而形成研究方案。我们在 100 个自然语言处理研究主题上，通过两位 LLM 评判者的成对比较，将 InsightAgents 与三种研究想法生成框架进行评估。在在线和离线知识设置下，InsightAgents 在两位评判者的评价中，五个评估维度的平均得分均最高。

abstract: Equation discovery solvers often use different data interfaces, equation representations and evaluation criteria, making their results difficult to compare. We present LegoSR, a unified framework for algebraic symbolic regression and differential equation discovery. LegoSR integrates seven solvers through a common equation representation and evaluation process, and supports searches constrained by partially known equations. Researchers can run solvers directly or use LegoSR Agent, which selects solvers and adapts searches based on solver knowledge, intermediate results and lessons from earlier tasks. On noisy ordinary and partial differential equation benchmarks, LegoSR Agent recovers nearly as many equations as the union of seven expert-tuned solvers and outperforms a generic agent with the same model, tools and budget by up to 29 percentage points. Three examples demonstrate basic use, adaptive solver selection and discovery guided by partial physical knowledge.
zh_abstract: 方程发现求解器往往采用不同的数据接口、方程表示和评估标准，使其结果难以比较。我们提出了 LegoSR，一个用于代数符号回归和微分方程发现的统一框架。LegoSR 通过共同的方程表示和评估流程整合了七种求解器，并支持以部分已知方程为约束的搜索。研究人员可以直接运行求解器，也可以使用 LegoSR Agent；后者基于求解器知识、中间结果以及先前任务的经验教训来选择求解器并调整搜索。在含噪声的常微分方程和偏微分方程基准上，LegoSR Agent 所恢复的方程数量接近七种经专家调优的求解器的并集，并且比使用相同模型、工具和预算的通用智能体最多高出 29 个百分点。三个示例展示了基本用法、自适应求解器选择以及由部分物理知识引导的发现。

title: VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering

abstract: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode topological patterns (e.g., connectivity and holes). These sources of information play distinct and complementary roles: visual-structural features provide the primary discriminative representation for clustering, while topological features provide additional global geometric cues for residual visual ambiguities. We introduce VTRL-Med, a progressive visual-structural learning framework with topology-guided regularization for medical image clustering. VTRL-Med first adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract image features that retain structural cues inherited from mask-supervised pretraining. It then generates reliable pseudo-labels through a two-step filtering process that combines prototype-based selection with k-nearest neighbor consistency validation. Finally, it progressively refines the visual branch while an auxiliary topology branch, constructed from persistent homology (PH) descriptors, provides additional geometric regularization during training. Across 13 medical image benchmarks, VTRL-Med achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance, improving average accuracy by 4.48% over existing methods. On three representative datasets, topology-guided regularization further improves accuracy by 1.3--4.3% over visual refinement alone.
zh_abstract: 深度聚类为分析大规模无标注医学图像数据集提供了一种有前景的方法，但现有主流方法仍面临两方面局限：它们可能忽略能够刻画物体边界和区域的、与类别无关的结构先验，并且没有显式编码拓扑模式（例如连通性和孔洞）。这两类信息发挥着不同且互补的作用：视觉-结构特征为聚类提供主要的判别性表示，而拓扑特征则为残余的视觉模糊提供额外的全局几何线索。我们提出了 VTRL-Med，一种用于医学图像聚类的、带有拓扑引导正则化的渐进式视觉-结构学习框架。VTRL-Med 首先对 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 进行适配，以提取保留了源自掩码监督预训练的结构线索的图像特征。随后，它通过结合基于原型的选择与 k 近邻一致性验证的两步过滤流程生成可靠的伪标签。最后，它在训练过程中逐步优化视觉分支，同时由基于持续同调（PH）描述符构建的辅助拓扑分支提供额外的几何正则化。在 13 个医学图像基准上，VTRL-Med 取得了最先进的聚类性能，平均准确率比现有方法提高 4.48%。在三个代表性数据集上，拓扑引导正则化相比仅进行视觉优化进一步将准确率提高了 1.3–4.3%。

title: In-silico Tandem Mass Spectral Libraries for the Blood Exposome and Metabolomics Workbench Databases: Application of Gemini Large Language Model

abstract: Human body contains endogenous metabolites, nutrients and xenobiotics chemicals. These chemicals can be detected in a biospecimen using high-resolution mass spectrometry instruments, yielding metabolomic and exposomic datasets. Mass spectral libraries are critical components of these workflows to annotate experimental data with chemical information. In this data descriptor, we report mass spectral libraries for human-relevant small molecules, that are generated using Google Gemini large-language model. Using an optimized chain-of-thought prompt and instructions, we have generated mass spectra for each compound at high/medium/low energy fragmentation level. Each spectrum was reported in the NIST MSP text format for easy to use by metabolomics software. These libraries cover 91,231 unique 2D structures from the Blood Exposome Database and the Metabolomics Workbench data repository. Technical validation was shown by comparing the Gemini-generated spectra against NIST 23 mass spectral database, which demonstrated 55% accuracy. LLMs represent a useful and accessible tool for expanding in-silico spectral libraries to annotate compounds in the HRMS data for human biospecimens and may accelerate the compound annotation in metabolomics and exposomics.
zh_abstract: 人体含有内源性代谢物、营养物质和外源性化学物质。这些化学物质可使用高分辨率质谱仪在生物样本中检测，从而产生代谢组学和暴露组学数据集。质谱库是这些工作流程中用化学信息注释实验数据的关键组成部分。在本数据说明中，我们报告了使用 Google Gemini 大语言模型生成的、面向人体相关小分子的质谱库。通过优化的思维链提示和指令，我们为每种化合物生成了高/中/低能量碎裂水平的质谱。每个谱图均以 NIST MSP 文本格式报告，便于代谢组学软件使用。这些谱库涵盖来自血液暴露组数据库（Blood Exposome Database）和 Metabolomics Workbench 数据仓库的 91,231 个独特二维结构。技术验证通过将 Gemini 生成的谱图与 NIST 23 质谱数据库进行比较完成，结果显示准确率为 55%。大语言模型是扩展计算机模拟谱库的一种有用且易得的工具，可用于注释人体生物样本高分辨质谱数据中的化合物，并可能加速代谢组学和暴露组学中的化合物注释。

title: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of HER2 Status from Whole-Brain MRI in Breast Cancer Brain Metastases

abstract: Purpose: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status is a key biomarker relevant for prognostication and treatment decision making in metastatic breast cancer. Thus, the aim of this work was to explore whether HER2 status can be predicted directly from whole-brain post-contrast T1-weighted (T1w) MRI scans in breast cancer brain metastases (BCBM) using deep learning, and whether providing explicit tumour segmentation information improves prediction. Methods: Using the publicly available BCBM-Radiogenomics dataset, we analysed 135 patients, including 70 HER2+ and 65 HER2- patients. Three approaches were implemented and evaluated: a conventional radiomics model, a simple fully convolutional network (SFCN) using T1w MRI scans alone, and an SFCN using T1w MRI scans with an expert-derived tumour mask as an additional input channel. Results: The radiomics model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.602 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.528--0.677) while the SFCN achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.667 (95% CI, 0.63--0.71) using T1w MRI scans alone, which increased to 0.692 (95% CI, 0.58--0.81) when an explicit tumour mask was additionally provided. Conclusion: However, the modest performance across all approaches demonstrates the difficulty of predicting HER2 status from structural MRI scans alone. The difference between the segmentation-free and mask-guided SFCN models suggests that much of the predictive signal captured by the deep-learning model may be learned directly from whole-brain T1w MRI without requiring explicit tumour delineation. These findings support further investigation of segmentation-free deep-learning approaches as a potential non-invasive strategy to support HER2 status determination in BCBM.
zh_abstract: 【目的】人表皮生长因子受体 2（HER2）状态是转移性乳腺癌预后判断和治疗决策的关键生物标志物。因此，本研究旨在探讨能否利用深度学习，直接从乳腺癌脑转移（BCBM）患者的全脑增强后 T1 加权（T1w）MRI 扫描中预测 HER2 状态，以及提供明确的肿瘤分割信息是否能改善预测。【方法】利用公开的 BCBM-Radiogenomics 数据集，我们分析了 135 名患者，其中 HER2 阳性 70 例，HER2 阴性 65 例。实施并评估了三种方法：传统影像组学模型、仅使用 T1w MRI 扫描的简单全卷积网络（SFCN），以及将专家勾画的肿瘤掩膜作为额外输入通道、与 T1w MRI 扫描一起输入的 SFCN。【结果】影像组学模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC）为 0.602（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.528–0.677）；仅使用 T1w MRI 扫描时，SFCN 的 ROC-AUC 为 0.667（95% CI：0.63–0.71），额外提供明确的肿瘤掩膜后升至 0.692（95% CI：0.58–0.81）。【结论】然而，所有方法的表现均较为有限，表明仅凭结构 MRI 扫描预测 HER2 状态存在困难。无分割与掩膜引导的 SFCN 模型之间的差异提示，深度学习模型所捕获的预测信号很大一部分可能直接来自全脑 T1w MRI，而无需明确的肿瘤勾画。这些发现支持进一步研究无需分割的深度学习方法，作为辅助确定 BCBM 患者 HER2 状态的一种潜在无创策略。

abstract: Reliable visual tracking of anatomical landmarks in endoscopic video is a key prerequisite for computer-assisted interventions in laryngeal surgery. While Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) is clinically established for enhancing vascular contrast, its effect on automated tracking relative to conventional White Light Imaging (WLI) remains unexplored. We present a quantitative comparison of landmark trackability in NBI and WLI using a forward-backward error framework applied to 61 endoscopic videos from 39 patients. Two regions of interest are evaluated: the vocal folds (VF) and mucosa with a prominent vascular pattern (MPVP). We compare a classical feature-based tracker (CSRT) against learning-based point trackers (CoTracker3-Online and TrackOnR) across both modalities. NBI consistently reduced the forward-backward error in both regions, reaching statistical significance for the vocal folds, while failure rates stayed low. These findings indicate that NBI can improve tracking robustness in laryngeal endoscopy, with implications for motion analysis, navigation, and robotic assistance.
zh_abstract: 在内镜视频中可靠地视觉跟踪解剖标志点，是喉部手术中计算机辅助干预的关键前提。窄带成像（NBI）在临床上已被确立可增强血管对比度，但相对于传统白光成像（WLI），其对自动跟踪的影响尚未得到研究。我们采用前向-后向误差框架，对来自 39 名患者的 61 段内镜视频进行了 NBI 与 WLI 下标志点可跟踪性的定量比较。评估了两个感兴趣区域：声带（VF）和具有明显血管模式的黏膜（MPVP）。我们在两种成像模式下比较了经典的基于特征的跟踪器（CSRT）与基于学习的点跟踪器（CoTracker3-Online 和 TrackOnR）。NBI 在两个区域均持续降低了前向-后向误差，其中声带区域达到统计学显著性，同时失败率保持在较低水平。这些发现表明，NBI 可以提高喉内镜中跟踪的稳健性，对运动分析、导航和机器人辅助具有重要意义。

title: Bottlenecks in cardiovascular prevention: Can artificial intelligence close the gap?

abstract: [Archives of cardiovascular diseases] Cardiovascular diseases are a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in France, despite current preventive strategies and evidence-based therapies. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising approach to overcoming several of these barriers, with the potential to improve cardiovascular prevention across the entire spectrum of care. Upstream, AI can enhance risk stratification through the integration of clinical, biological, imaging, environmental, behavioural and longitudinal data, thereby moving cardiovascular prevention toward an AI-augmented precision medicine paradigm, in which risk assessments are increasingly individualized. Downstream, AI-enabled clinical decision support systems may improve guideline implementation, reduce therapeutic inertia and support individualized treatment optimization. Generative AI may also strengthen patient education, personalize risk communication, promote healthy behaviours and improve long-term adherence through adaptive coaching and continuous monitoring. However, translating these promises into meaningful improvements in cardiovascular outcomes will require overcoming substantial technological, organizational, regulatory and societal challenges. These challenges include ensuring data quality and information system interoperability, addressing inequalities in access to digital health technologies, improving the acceptability of AI among patients and healthcare professionals through rigorous evaluation and, critically, adapting healthcare systems to absorb, triage and manage the potentially large number of at-risk individuals identified by AI-enabled prevention strategies. By examining these barriers, this review highlights that AI mainly shifts the bottlenecks of prevention downstream, rather than removing them, and outlines the conditions required for AI, beyond intrinsic performance, to improve cardiovascular prevention in routine clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Archives of cardiovascular diseases] 尽管已有现行的预防策略和循证治疗，心血管疾病仍是法国发病和死亡的主要原因。人工智能（AI）已成为克服其中若干障碍的有前景的途径，有望改善整个医疗链条上的心血管预防。在上游，AI可通过整合临床、生物学、影像、环境、行为和纵向数据来增强风险分层，从而使心血管预防迈向AI增强的精准医学范式，其中风险评估日益个体化。在下游，AI赋能的临床决策支持系统可改善指南的落实，减少治疗惰性，并支持个体化治疗优化。生成式AI还可通过自适应指导和持续监测，加强患者教育、实现个性化风险沟通、促进健康行为并提高长期依从性。然而，要将这些前景转化为心血管结局的切实改善，需要克服重大的技术、组织、监管和社会挑战。这些挑战包括：确保数据质量和信息系统的互操作性；解决数字健康技术可及性方面的不平等；通过严格评估提高患者和医疗专业人员对AI的接受度；以及至关重要的是，使医疗体系能够吸收、分诊和管理由AI赋能的预防策略所识别出的可能数量庞大的高风险个体。通过审视这些障碍，本综述指出，AI主要是将预防的瓶颈转移到下游，而非将其消除，并概述了除自身性能之外，AI在常规临床实践中改善心血管预防所需的条件。

title: Artificial Intelligence and AI-Adjacent Digital Technologies in Nursing Practice Within Gastroenterology: A Scoping Review of Current Applications, Challenges, and Future Directions.
zh_title: 消化科护理中的AI及相关数字技术：范围综述
summary: 按PRISMA-ScR检索四个数据库，仅纳入11项研究，梳理AI及相关数字技术在消化科护理中的应用、挑战与方向。
key_points: 检索到184条记录，纳入11项
涉及临床决策支持与工作流等应用

abstract: [Nursing reports (Pavia, Italy)] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical gastroenterology, with emerging applications in nursing contexts. However, the extent and nature of these applications in gastroenterology nursing remain under-explored. This scoping review aimed to map the current landscape of AI and closely related AI-adjacent digital technologies in gastroenterology nursing. Methods: Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guideline, PubMed, Medline, Web of Science, and Scopus were searched for peer-reviewed, English-language studies published since 2000, and the findings were synthesized narratively. Results: Of 184 records identified, 11 studies were included, highlighting the potential of these technologies in clinical decision support, workflow optimization, patient education, and endoscopy assistance. Reported benefits include gains in workflow efficiency, technical accuracy, and reduced administrative workload; direct evidence of improved nursing-led patient outcomes was reported in only a minority of studies. Challenges encompass limited nurse-led research, insufficient external validation, implementation gaps, and ethical concerns. Conclusions: Greater nurse involvement in AI development is essential to drive paradigm shifts in clinical practice. This review synthesizes evidence to inform future applications, research, and policy in AI-enhanced gastroenterology nursing.
zh_abstract: [Nursing reports（意大利帕维亚）]【背景/目的】人工智能（AI）日益融入临床胃肠病学，并在护理场景中出现新的应用。然而，这些应用在胃肠病护理中的范围和性质仍未得到充分探讨。本范围综述旨在描绘胃肠病护理中AI及与AI密切相关的数字技术的现状。【方法】遵循系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目的范围综述扩展版（PRISMA-ScR）指南，检索PubMed、Medline、Web of Science和Scopus中2000年以来发表的同行评审英文研究，并对结果进行叙述性综合。【结果】在检索到的184条记录中，纳入11项研究，这些研究凸显了这些技术在临床决策支持、工作流程优化、患者教育和内镜辅助方面的潜力。报告的获益包括工作流程效率提高、技术准确性提升以及行政工作负担减轻；仅少数研究报告了由护士主导的患者结局改善的直接证据。挑战包括护士主导的研究有限、外部验证不足、实施差距和伦理问题。【结论】护士更多地参与AI开发对于推动临床实践的范式转变至关重要。本综述综合了相关证据，以为AI增强的胃肠病护理的未来应用、研究和政策提供参考。

title: flodl-bio: First Rust data, transformers and model layer for entire deep learning on biological sequences
zh_title: flodl-bio：面向生物序列深度学习的Rust库
summary: 该预印本介绍基于libtorch的Rust库flodl-bio，提供序列编码、FASTA解析、图构建、评估指标及卷积滤波器motif导出等功能。
key_points: 称为首个面向生物应用的Rust深度学习库
含one-hot与k-mer编码、图构建工具
支持AUROC/AUPRC及MEME motif导出
reason: 工具库，增量档，摘要无性能验证
abstract: Python ecosystem dominates the deep learning framework. flodl-bio is a Rust crate that extends flodl, a libtorch-backed deep-learning framework, with deep learning on biological sequences. To our knowledge, flodl-bio is the first Rust crate that provides a comprehensive and practical deep learning for the biological applications, which includes the alphabet-aware sequence encoding, including one-hot and k-mer representations, padded sequences, and channels-first batches. It also includes several FASTA parsing and graph construction utilities for adjacency matrices, GCN-normalised adjacency matrices, graph Laplacians, residue contact maps, and de Bruijn graphs. Among the added functionalities, it includes AUROC and AUPRC with their associated curves; classification metrics, and the export of learned convolutional filters as MEME motifs and seeded splits. Deep biological learning includes a multi-width motif CNN, a dilated residual CNN, bidirectional LSTM and GRU architectures, and transformer encoder. On the five human transcription-factor-binding datasets in the GUE benchmark, a motif CNN with approximately 10,000 parameters, trained from scratch, outperforms all published CNN baselines. It also superseded the 2.5-billion-parameter Nucleotide Transformer on two datasets and DNABERT-2 on one. Given a fixed hardware configuration and software stack, experiments are reproducible at the bit level. See Supplementary Table S2 of Supplementary Material. flodl-bio is written in Rust and released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/sablokg/flodl-bio. The core builds with stable Rust and has no dependencies. The model tier is enabled with the flodl Cargo feature (cuda for NVIDIA GPUs) and requires libtorch and Rust 1.91 or later. The evaluation harness is in the repository's experiments directory, and the complete run outputs are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23321850
zh_abstract: Python 生态系统在深度学习框架中占据主导地位。flodl-bio 是一个 Rust crate，它在基于 libtorch 的深度学习框架 flodl 之上，扩展了面向生物序列的深度学习功能。据我们所知，flodl-bio 是首个为生物学应用提供全面且实用的深度学习功能的 Rust crate，其包括感知字母表的序列编码（含 one-hot 和 k-mer 表示）、填充序列以及通道优先（channels-first）的批次。它还包括若干 FASTA 解析和图构建工具，可用于邻接矩阵、GCN 归一化邻接矩阵、图拉普拉斯矩阵、残基接触图和 de Bruijn 图。在新增功能中，包含 AUROC 和 AUPRC 及其相应曲线、分类指标，以及将学习到的卷积滤波器导出为 MEME 基序和带种子的数据划分。深度生物学习部分包括多宽度基序 CNN、扩张残差 CNN、双向 LSTM 和 GRU 架构以及 Transformer 编码器。在 GUE 基准的五个人类转录因子结合数据集上，一个约有10,000个参数、从头训练的基序 CNN 优于所有已发表的 CNN 基线；它在两个数据集上还超过了25亿参数的 Nucleotide Transformer，在一个数据集上超过了 DNABERT-2。在固定的硬件配置和软件栈下，实验可在比特级别复现。参见补充材料的补充表 S2。flodl-bio 以 Rust 编写，采用 MIT 许可发布，地址为 https://github.com/sablokg/flodl-bio。核心部分可用稳定版 Rust 构建，且无依赖项。模型层通过 flodl Cargo 特性启用（NVIDIA GPU 使用 cuda），需要 libtorch 和 Rust 1.91 或更高版本。评估工具位于仓库的 experiments 目录中，完整的运行输出已存档于 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23321850

title: Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)
zh_title: 轻量医学ViT的跨架构知识蒸馏：LiteMed-ViT的前景与局限
summary: 提出0.234M参数的双token ViT，从ResNet18蒸馏，在三个MedMNIST子集上优于三个紧凑CNN基线（预印本）。
key_points: 参数量比ResNet18教师少47.8倍
内存占用仅0.89 MB
含卷积stem与类别均衡蒸馏目标
reason: 仅在小型MedMNIST上评估，无外部验证，增量档
abstract: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.
zh_abstract: 在医疗现场运行用于医学图像分析的深度模型，对标准架构而言颇具挑战：卷积神经网络（CNN）对边缘设备往往过于笨重，而视觉 Transformer（ViT）需要海量训练数据来弥补缺失的归纳偏置。本研究探讨了用于训练数据高效 ViT 的双 token 蒸馏在跨架构应用时（从基于 CNN 的教师模型到轻量级 ViT 学生模型）能推进到何种程度。我们提出 LiteMed-ViT，一种具有卷积主干（stem）和类别均衡蒸馏目标的双 token ViT；其参数量为 0.234M，比其 ResNet18 教师模型少 47.8 倍，内存占用仅 0.89 MB。在三个模态和类别均衡程度各异的 MedMNIST 子集上与三种紧凑型 CNN 基线比较，LiteMed-ViT 在 BloodMNIST（95.05%）上的准确率高于全部三个基线，在 PathMNIST（89.15%）上高于其中两个。在 MedMNIST-C 损坏条件下，它在所有子集上的鲁棒性至少与每个紧凑型 CNN 相当，在 BloodMNIST 和 PathMNIST 上优于它们，且随着严重程度增加，其相对地位并未下降。我们特别关注确定性能出现平台期的具体条件。在 DermaMNIST 上，LiteMed-ViT 的平衡准确率仍比最强的紧凑型 CNN 低最多 1.9 个点，且在输入分辨率提高至 224 像素时并未获益，而 ResNet18 则提升了 12.6 个点。更强的教师模型并不会产生更准确的学生模型，而过度自信的教师模型会降低其在 DermaMNIST 上的平衡准确率，除非加以校准。

title: Exploring Artificial Intelligence-Generated Feedback for Pharmacy Students.
zh_title: 药学学生对AI生成反馈的探索性研究
summary: 对148名药学二年级学生的试点调查，评估AI助手依据评分标准生成的作业反馈在质量与学习影响上的感受。
key_points: 148名学生使用AI助手对草稿作业给出反馈
问卷评估反馈与评分标准的一致性、准确性、清晰度和语气

abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into educational environments is accelerating, with growing interest in its potential to enhance learning outcomes. This pilot study aimed to assess student perceptions regarding the quality and educational impact of AI-generated feedback. Second-professional-year pharmacy students (n = 148) enrolled in a drug literature evaluation course received AI-generated feedback for a draft assignment which required students to critically evaluate a recently published journal article. Feedback was generated by an AI assistant that offered iterative feedback based on the assignment rubric. After the activity, students completed an electronic survey instrument evaluating the AI feedback regarding its alignment with rubric criteria, accuracy, clarity, and tone. Student perceptions of the feedback's impact on learning were also assessed. A total of 148 students (100%) completed the activity and responded to at least one item of the survey tool. Most students agreed with the AI-generated feedback for each section of the assignment in regard to clarity (61.5% to 76.2%) and tone (66.9% to 74.3%), with lower agreement related to alignment with the rubric (33.8% to 60.4%) and accuracy (34.5% to 54.2%). Students also expressed concern about the reliability of AI feedback (71.2%) and risk for plagiarism (50%). AI-generated feedback was positively received in some areas. However, students expressed apprehension regarding its accuracy, reliability, and potential accusation of plagiarism. These findings suggest further refinement is necessary to enhance AI trustworthiness and educational value in academic settings.
zh_abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）正加速融入教育环境，人们对其提升学习成效的潜力兴趣日增。本试点研究旨在评估学生对 AI 生成反馈的质量及其教育影响的看法。修读药物文献评价课程的药学专业二年级学生（n = 148）对一份作业草稿获得了 AI 生成的反馈，该作业要求学生对一篇新近发表的期刊文章进行批判性评价。反馈由一个 AI 助手生成，该助手依据作业评分标准提供迭代式反馈。活动结束后，学生填写电子问卷，从与评分标准的契合度、准确性、清晰度和语气等方面评价 AI 反馈，同时也评估了学生对该反馈对学习影响的看法。共有 148 名学生（100%）完成了活动，并至少回答了问卷中的一个条目。对于作业的每个部分，多数学生认同 AI 生成反馈的清晰度（61.5% 至 76.2%）和语气（66.9% 至 74.3%），而对与评分标准的契合度（33.8% 至 60.4%）和准确性（34.5% 至 54.2%）的认同度较低。学生还对 AI 反馈的可靠性（71.2%）和抄袭风险（50%）表示担忧。AI 生成的反馈在某些方面获得了积极评价。然而，学生对其准确性、可靠性以及可能被指控抄袭表示忧虑。这些发现提示，需要进一步改进，以提高 AI 在学术环境中的可信度和教育价值。
